question.text: A thin plastic sheet of refractive index <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mtext>1.6</mtext></math> is used to cover one of the slits, among the two slits, in a double-slit arrangement. The central point on the screen is now occupied by what would have been the <math><msup><mrow><mn>7</mn></mrow><mrow><mi>t</mi><mi>h</mi></mrow></msup></math> bright fringe before the thin plastic sheet was used. If the wavelength of light is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>600</mn><mo> </mo><mi>nm</mi></math>, the thickness (in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>μm</mi></math>) of the thin plastic sheet is

solution.text:
The change in path =μ-1t. This path length change the position of bright fringe upto seventh bright fringe. 

t( μ−1 )=7λ

t= 7( 600× 10 −9 ) ( 1.6−1 )

=7×10−6 m     ⇒7 μm
